newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's ATN Holdings changes par value.
newsitem.headline: Manila's ATN Holdings changes par value.

text.p: The Philippines' Securities and Exchange Commission has approved a change in ATN Holdings Inc's par value to one peso from 0.01 peso.
ATN said on Monday the change will be reflected in the stock exchange's computer system on June 18.

ATN was recently converted into a holding firm from a mining concern. It has a total authorised capital stock of 200 million pesos divided into 120 million class A shares and 80 million B shares with a par value of one peso per share.
